_about: Suggested starting sets of design pipelines by product kind (#158, spec #156). A suggestion only: the pipelines are picked per project at kickoff by what the project needs (#159), and a project may add or drop any of them. Checked by check-pipelines.js: every pipeline in a set is in the catalogue, and every pipeline a set lists has the pipelines it depends on in the same set.

sets.productKind: Product UI: a website or app people use through screens
sets.why: Most product work is the brand and the screens; nothing in it is a story, a character or a 3D model.

sets.productKind: A website or app that uses 3D as a design element
sets.why: The screens carry the product; the 3D models are a design element on them, with no game pipeline needed.
A game usually needs all six: its name and menus, a story with scenes, characters, and models. A 2D game or one with no plot drops what it does not need.
